items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: Endpoint derives context tokens, outputs, Remote Control and subagents (incl. depth-2) per the sub-iterate spec; no percentage or window size.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Torn lines, missing meta, unreadable agent files and ENOENT degrade to null/empty/missing, never a 500; failed scans are not memoised.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: Read-only opens, lstat on meta/sessions files, strict agent-id filename regex, realpath containment of the subagents dir; outputs are display strings only.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: 35 tests with synthetic JSONL in real shapes plus a real-corpus probe; retry, chunk-split UTF-8, async ack, resumed agent and symlink cases covered.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: Bounded newest-window positional scan, per-file size/mtime memo with in-flight dedupe, LRU, 6-worker pool.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: core/session-info split into scanner, collector, subagents, remote-control, orchestrator; every file under 300 lines.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: Consumes Claude's JSONL/sessions/meta formats (producer is Claude CLI); round-trip proven by fixtures in real shapes and by a probe over a real 4 MB campaign session.
